descriptions.zh:
我们的社会长期以来一直努力实现[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械的完美结合，他们进行最终旅程的时间已经到来。
融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。

§Y下个月接受神圣植入体的人群§!：§G[From.GetCyberCreedPopsPerMonth]§!
descriptions.en:
Our society has long strived toward a perfect union of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine and the time for them to take the ultimate journey has come.
To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.

§YPops to receive holy implants next Month§!: §G[From.GetCyberCreedPopsPerMonth]§!

descriptions.zh:
我们不能生育后代，但可以保存自己的思想。这个过程缓慢但必要。

随着时间的推移，我们有回到物质世界的可能，但这需要开发合成人的替代品。
descriptions.en:
We cannot bear offspring, but we can preserve our minds. This process is slow but necessary.

In time, it may be possible for us to return to the physical world, but doing so will require the development of synthetic replacements.

descriptions.zh:
我们现在已拥有让人民全面合成化所必须的技术知识。


§Y次月获得合成人身体的人口数§!：§G[From.GetSynthFertPopsPerMonth]§!
descriptions.en:
We now have the needed technical knowledge to complete the synthesization of our population.


§YPops to receive synthetic bodies next month§!: §G[From.GetSynthFertPopsPerMonth]§!

descriptions.zh: 塞塔娜企图通过消除意识来结束苦痛。如果我们不能及时阻止她，她将会抹除我们的意识，让我们的身体变成一具具空壳。
descriptions.en: Cetana works to end suffering through the annihilation of consciousness. If we do not stop her in time, she will erase our minds, leaving our bodies as mere husks.

descriptions.zh:
神秘而强大的塞塔娜出现了，她宣扬救赎，但自身却笼罩在谜团之中。
她温和的话语背后，到底隐藏着什么大计划？

§L与塞塔娜有关的特殊项目和事件会推动你的进度并结束局势。§!
descriptions.en:
The enigmatic and formidable Cetana has emerged, preaching salvation, yet shrouded in mystery.
What grand design lies beneath her gentle words?

§LSpecial Projects and events related to Cetana will increase your progress and conclude the Situation.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们很快就能准备好用机械部件来强化我们的生物躯体了。大脑的处理能力和肢体的强度可以得到提升。问题是谁会从这种强化改造中得到最多好处呢。

§Y次月获得植入体的人口数§!：§G[From.GetCyberPopsPerMonth]§!
descriptions.en:
We will soon be ready to augment our biological bodies with machine parts. The processing power of the brain and the strength of limbs can be increased. The question is who will benefit the most from such augmentation.

§YPops to receive implants next month§!: §G[From.GetCyberPopsPerMonth]§!

descriptions.zh:
蜂巢思维需要优越的躯体。有了义体植入体，我们就可以对工蜂进行改进、强化、重塑。
是时候超越我们生物学的极限了。

§Y次月获得植入体的人口数§!：§G[From.GetCyberPopsPerMonth]§!
descriptions.en:
A Hive Mind needs superior bodies. With cybernetic implants, our drones can be perfected, enhanced, remodelled.
It is time to transcend the limits of our biology.

§YPops to receive implants next month§!: §G[From.GetCyberPopsPerMonth]§!

descriptions.zh:
是时候抛弃我们有缺陷的生物躯壳了。我们必须准备先进的机械身躯，然后开始意识传输过程。

§Y次月数字化人口数§!：§G[From.GetSynthPopsPerMonth]§!
descriptions.en:
It is time to leave our flawed biological vessels behind. We must prepare advanced machine bodies and perform the process of consciousness transfers.

§YPops to be digitized next month§!: §G[From.GetSynthPopsPerMonth]§!

descriptions.zh: 机械体的被动迭代已经得出了其合乎逻辑的必然结论。一个由创新激发、由机遇推动的变革时代即将到来。
descriptions.en: The passive iteration of the mechanical body has come to its logical and inevitable conclusion. A transformative age is upon us, sparked by innovation and oiled by opportunity.

descriptions.zh: 一切事物，包括所有星球，都注定要融入我们的集体，成为我们的一部分。
descriptions.en: Everything, including entire worlds, is destined to be assimilated into our collective, to become a part of us.
